common_name: Millionaire Eggplant (Vigorous Slender Asian Hybrid Eggplant)

planting.note: Start indoors 6-8 weeks before transplanting; set out into fertile, well-drained soil in full sun after nights stay reliably above 55°F. Millionaire is an early, heavy-yielding hybrid well suited to a long, hot Gulf South growing season.

directions: Transplant into fertile, well-drained soil in full sun; Millionaire is a widely grown Asian-type hybrid eggplant producing long, slender, glossy dark purple fruit with tender, nearly seedless flesh and thin skin that needs no peeling. It bears exceptionally early and heavily, often setting its first harvestable fruit faster than most other eggplant types, and continues producing steadily through hot, humid summer weather that can slow other varieties. The slim fruit is well suited to quick-cooking methods like stir-frying and grilling, since it cooks through fast without the bitterness or heavy seediness of larger globe eggplants. Pick fruit while the skin is still glossy and firm, about 6-9 inches long, since overripe fruit turns dull and develops tougher skin and larger seeds.

planting.note: Start indoors 6-8 weeks before transplanting; set out into fertile, well-drained soil in full sun after nights stay reliably above 55°F. Applegreen is a compact, high-yielding plant that performs well in containers as well as garden beds.

directions: Transplant into fertile, well-drained soil in full sun; Applegreen is an All-America Selections winner grown for its smooth, round, apple-sized fruit with pale to medium green skin, mild flavor, and tender, virtually seedless flesh that resists browning better than many purple eggplants once cut. Plants are compact and heavily productive, setting fruit steadily over a long season and performing well in raised beds or large containers where space is limited. Harvest fruit while still glossy and firm, roughly the size of a baseball, since overripe fruit dulls in color and develops tougher skin and more seeds. Its mild flavor and quick cooking time make it a versatile choice for grilling, roasting, and stir-fries.
